tools.name: assistant-toolkit-add-context
tools.description:
Adds the object to the chat context.
Use this it for objects that are useful long-term for the conversation.

obj.description:
Object to add to the chat context.
An object reference (see "Object reference" in Definitions).

tools.name: assistant-toolkit-remove-context
tools.description:
Removes the object from the chat context.
Use this it for objects that are no longer useful for the conversation.

obj.description:
Object to remove from the chat context.
An object reference (see "Object reference" in Definitions).

content.content:
## Skills Definitions

<skill>
  You can bind objects into the chat's context so later turns can see them, and unbind them again.
  Reading and writing the objects themselves — including types, relations and tags — is the
  Database skill's job (plugin-space).
</skill>

## Definitions

<definition name="Object reference">
A parameter described as an object reference takes the object's URI exactly as it appears in Context Objects
or in a tool result, e.g. echo://<spaceId>/<objectId>.
Also accepted: <spaceId>:<objectId>; a bare <objectId> for an object in the current space; and
dxn:<typename>:<version> for a type that exists in the registry. A leading @ is ignored.
</definition>
Remove the object echo://BDJXMULPW5FB55UZ7KP5HLDHVTXUTHE2U/01JGFJJZ00G0WKQSJGMAKCNTAX from the chat context.
